title: SWAP5 TB09-003 Restricted Drainage x Changing Bottom Boundary Integrated Qualification

owner_authorities.drainage_runtime: F-CI36 current-canonical admitted restricted DIVDRA callsite
owner_authorities.soil_water_solver: current-canonical serialized reference Full Richards path
owner_authorities.mass: F-TB01 hard mass gate plus current canonical mass-accounting contract

scope.purpose: Execute and qualify the first bounded F-TB09 integrated interaction case that is already realizable on current production composition without changing production source.
scope.runtime_profile: restricted serialized single-column Full Richards runtime with single-level positive DIVDRA, explicit hydraulic view and prescribed-head SWBOTB=5 lower boundary
scope.time_profile: two consecutive generic numeric intervals with a committed boundary between them

requirements: active DIVDRA publication in both intervals
prescribed bottom head changes across the committed interval boundary
the resulting signed bottom flux changes
explicit drainage hydraulic view changes enough to alter the selected water-table node
both interval ledgers are complete and individually satisfy the hard mass gate
full-window combined ledger satisfies the same hard mass gate
O0 and O2 executions are bitwise text-identical
exact F-VQ51 restricted DIVDRA verifier remains green against the current production composition

mass_contract.tolerance_meaning: arithmetic closure gate only; never an allowance for lost water
mass_contract.interval_identity: Delta(S_soil) = signed external water amount over the interval
mass_contract.derived_signed_bottom_flux: qbot = (total_in-total_out)/DeltaT + qtop + Q_divdra for this restricted fixture, because root uptake, irrigation/source terms, surface storage and runoff are inactive
mass_contract.bottom_sign_rule: bottom flux is represented exactly once; no upward/downward double booking

nonclaims: No drainage exchange-law science qualification beyond the already admitted F-CI36 restricted owner scope.
No fully implicit or trial-state drainage response.
No negative/infiltration drainage or multilevel drainage qualification.
No qualification of all bottom-boundary modes; this workunit uses prescribed-head SWBOTB=5 only.
No promotion of the other seven F-TB09 catalog cases.
close_rule: The exit target is attained only on an exact branch head for which the dedicated GitHub Actions workflow passes its start-head check, qualification runner and end-head check. Any later commit requires a new exact-head run.
